recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球一側有一道深凹的裂口，把細胞分成兩個突出的「鉗口」，形如蘑菇或鉗子（pincer / mushroom-shaped cell）；周圍其他紅血球大小與形狀大致正常，因此這是一個孤立但典型的形狀異常。
features: Single red cell (arrow) with a deep notch-like cleft on one side producing two knob-like projections (pincer/mushroom shape)
Remaining red cells largely normocytic and round, many with reduced central pallor
Mild anisocytosis without prominent schistocytes, spherocyte clusters or target cells
No red cell inclusions, parasites or nucleated red cells in this field
Leukocytes and platelets are not represented in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of mostly normocytic, round red cells with mild anisocytosis. A single red cell (arrow) shows a deep one-sided cleft producing two small projections, giving a pincer-like or mushroom-shaped appearance. Schistocytes, clusters of spherocytes, target cells and red cell inclusions are not evident in this field. This is an isolated pincer (mushroom-shaped) red cell; the finding is nonspecific and should be interpreted with the clinical context, here SARS-CoV-2 infection, and screened for hemolysis or a membrane disorder if frequent.

ddx.vs: Schistocytes are smaller fragments with sharp angular edges or horn-like points, whereas the pincer cell is a near-full-size cell with a single rounded central notch.
Bite cells have a semicircular peripheral bite with blister cells and Heinz bodies, not a narrow cleft between two knobs.
Stomatocytes have a slit-like central pallor and knizocytes a central bar, both lacking a cleft that reaches the cell margin.
Artifacts involve many cells in thick areas or show overlap, whereas a true pincer cell is isolated in a well-spread monolayer.
